## Configuration

```{r libraries}
check_packages(c("Seurat", "SeuratObject", "CellChat", "patchwork", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "future", "here"))

library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(future)

# CellChat has high peak memory use; 6 workers is a balanced default for 9950X3D + 96G RAM.
plan("multicore", workers = 6)
options(future.fork.enable = TRUE)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 88 * 1024^3)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths()
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "08_CellChat"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "08_CellChat"))
```

## CellChat helper

```{r helper}
create_cellchat <- function(seurat_obj, group_name, min_cells = 10) {
  cells <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[normalize_group_levels(seurat_obj$Group) == group_name]
  sub_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells)
  DefaultAssay(sub_obj) <- "RNA"
  sub_obj <- safe_join_layers(sub_obj, assay = "RNA")
  sub_obj <- NormalizeData(sub_obj, verbose = FALSE)

  data_input <- get_assay_matrix(sub_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
  meta <- sub_obj@meta.data
  meta$labels <- meta$CellType_Fine

  cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data_input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels")
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat, do.fast = FALSE)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean")
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = min_cells)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
  cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
  cellchat
}

run_cellchat_pair <- function(obj, tissue_name) {
  obj$Group <- normalize_group_levels(obj$Group)
  chat_control <- create_cellchat(obj, "Control")
  chat_experimental <- create_cellchat(obj, "Experimental")
  merged <- mergeCellChat(list(Control = chat_control, Experimental = chat_experimental), add.names = c("Control", "Experimental"))

  p_count <- compareInteractions(merged, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2), measure = "count") +
    labs(title = paste(tissue_name, "number of interactions"))
  p_weight <- compareInteractions(merged, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2), measure = "weight") +
    labs(title = paste(tissue_name, "interaction strength"))
  save_pub_plot(p_count + p_weight, paste0("08_", sanitize_label(tissue_name), "_cellchat_global"), fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)

  pdf(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("08_", sanitize_label(tissue_name), "_cellchat_diff_network.pdf")), width = 12, height = 6)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
  netVisual_diffInteraction(merged, weight.scale = TRUE, measure = "count")
  netVisual_diffInteraction(merged, weight.scale = TRUE, measure = "weight")
  dev.off()

  saveRDS(merged, file.path(paths$rds_dir, paste0("08_", sanitize_label(tissue_name), "_cellchat_merged.rds")))
  merged
}
```

## Spleen CellChat

```{r spleen_cellchat}
sc_spleen <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "01_spleen_annotated.rds"))
chat_spleen <- run_cellchat_pair(sc_spleen, "Spleen")

spleen_sources <- intersect(c("Tfh cells", "Naive CD4 T cells", "Central memory CD4 T cells"), unique(sc_spleen$CellType_Fine))
spleen_targets <- intersect(c("GC B cells", "Plasma cell-like", "Naive B cells", "Memory B cell-like"), unique(sc_spleen$CellType_Fine))

if (length(spleen_sources) > 0 && length(spleen_targets) > 0) {
  p_spleen_bubble <- netVisual_bubble(
    chat_spleen,
    sources.use = spleen_sources,
    targets.use = spleen_targets,
    comparison = c(1, 2),
    angle.x = 45
  ) +
    labs(title = "Spleen differential signaling")
  save_pub_plot(p_spleen_bubble, "08_spleen_cellchat_t_to_b_bubble", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 12)
}
```

## Bone marrow CellChat

```{r bm_cellchat}
sc_bm <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "02_bonemarrow_annotated.rds"))
chat_bm <- run_cellchat_pair(sc_bm, "BoneMarrow")

bm_targets <- intersect(c("Plasma cell-like", "Plasmablast-like", "Naive or mature B cells"), unique(sc_bm$CellType_Fine))
if (length(bm_targets) > 0) {
  p_bm_bubble <- netVisual_bubble(
    chat_bm,
    targets.use = bm_targets,
    comparison = c(1, 2),
    angle.x = 45
  ) +
    labs(title = "Bone marrow differential signaling")
  save_pub_plot(p_bm_bubble, "08_bm_cellchat_plasma_cell_like_bubble", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 12)
}
```
